description: Real Gmail API 401 for messages.get after the access token expired mid-run, copied from logs/micro_gmail_backup.log. The message ID is replaced with a placeholder; no request headers or credentials are recorded.
context: Returned after 7 consecutive rate-limit 403 retries on the same message.

error.message: Request had invalid authentication credentials. Expected OAuth 2 access token, login cookie or other valid authentication credential. See https://developers.google.com/identity/sign-in/web/devconsole-project.
